### 🔗 Link Protection

**Microsoft Defender for Office 365** protects your links across a variety of platforms including **Email**, **Teams**, **SharePoint**, and **Office Apps**.

content.query:
// Link Protection by Platform
UrlClickEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Platform = case(
    Workload has "Email" or Workload has "Exchange" or isempty(Workload), "📧 Mail / Outlook",
    Workload has "Teams", "💬 Teams",
    Workload has "SharePoint" or Workload has "OneDrive", "📁 SharePoint/OneDrive",
    Workload has "Office", "📄 Office Apps",
    "🔗 Other")
| summarize 
    TotalClicks = count(),
    BlockedClicks = countif(IsClickedThrough == false),
    ThreatClicks = countif(isnotempty(ThreatTypes)),
    UniqueURLs = dcount(Url),
    UniqueUsers = dcount(AccountUpn)
    by Platform
| extend BlockRate = strcat(round(toreal(BlockedClicks) / TotalClicks * 100, 1), "%")
| order by TotalClicks desc
content.title: 🌐 Link Protection by Platform

UrlClickEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Outcome = case(

content.json: **Time-of-Click Protection:** Microsoft Defender for Office 365 scans links at delivery, but also when they are clicked - allowing decisions to be made after any reputation change. ### 🎯 Recent Notable Campaigns & Threat Analytics

**Microsoft Security Research** tracks threat actors and campaigns targeting organizations. Below are notable patterns detected in your environment.

content.query:
// Recent Attack Campaigns Detected
EmailEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(ThreatTypes)
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| extend CampaignPattern = case(
    Subject has_any ("password", "expire", "reset", "verify", "urgent") and ThreatTypes has "Phish", "🎣 Credential Harvesting",
    Subject has_any ("invoice", "payment", "wire", "transfer", "urgent") and ThreatTypes has "Phish", "💰 BEC / Financial Fraud",
    Subject has_any ("shared", "document", "onedrive", "sharepoint", "view") and ThreatTypes has "Phish", "📄 Fake File Share",
    Subject has_any ("voicemail", "vm", "missed call", "fax") and ThreatTypes has "Phish", "📞 Voicemail/Fax Lure",
    Subject has_any ("mfa", "authenticator", "security", "verify", "unusual") and ThreatTypes has "Phish", "🔐 MFA/Security Alert Lure",
    Subject has_any ("shipping", "delivery", "package", "fedex", "ups", "dhl") and ThreatTypes has "Phish", "📦 Shipping Notification",
    ThreatTypes has "Malware", "🦠 Malware Distribution",
    ThreatTypes has "Spam", "📧 Spam Campaign",
    "⚠️ Other Threat")
| summarize 
    EmailCount = count(),
    UniqueRecipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress),
    UniqueSenders = dcount(SenderFromAddress),
    Domains = make_set(SenderFromDomain, 5),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    Blocked = countif(DeliveryAction in ("Blocked", "Quarantined")),
    Delivered = countif(DeliveryAction == "Delivered")
    by CampaignPattern
| extend BlockRate = strcat(round(toreal(Blocked) / EmailCount * 100, 1), "%")
| extend Risk = case(
    Delivered > 0 and CampaignPattern has_any ("BEC", "Credential", "MFA"), "🔴 HIGH",
    Delivered > 0, "🟠 MEDIUM",
    "🟢 BLOCKED")
| order by EmailCount desc
| project Risk, CampaignPattern, EmailCount, UniqueRecipients, UniqueSenders, BlockRate, Delivered, FirstSeen, LastSeen, Domains
content.title: 🎯 Attack Campaign Patterns Detected

### 📬 Delivery Locations

**Microsoft Defender for Office 365** classifies messages with a verdict and confidence level. Based on your policies and tenant configuration, phish and spam threats will be delivered to **Inbox**, **Junk Mail Folder**, **Quarantine**, or a **custom location**. Any overrides you have made can also impact delivery location.

content.query:
// Delivery Location Distribution for Threats
EmailEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| where ThreatTypes has_any ("Phish", "Spam", "Malware")
| extend Location = case(
    DeliveryLocation == "Inbox/folder", "📥 Inbox",
    DeliveryLocation has "Junk", "📁 Junk Folder",
    DeliveryLocation has "Quarantine" or DeliveryAction == "Quarantined", "🔒 Quarantine",
    DeliveryAction == "Blocked", "🚫 Blocked",
    isnotempty(DeliveryLocation), strcat("⚙️ Custom: ", DeliveryLocation),
    "❓ Unknown")
| summarize Count = count() by Location, ThreatType = case(ThreatTypes has "Phish", "Phish", ThreatTypes has "Malware", "Malware", "Spam")
| order by Count desc

## 🔴 Business Email Compromise (BEC) Detection

**MITRE ATT&CK:** T1566.001 - Spearphishing Attachment, T1566.002 - Spearphishing Link, T1534 - Internal Spearphishing

| BEC Type | Description | Key Indicators |
|----------|-------------|----------------|
| **CEO/Executive Fraud** | Impersonating executives to request wire transfers | Urgency, financial requests, display name spoofing |
| **Vendor/Invoice Fraud** | Compromised vendor accounts or impersonation | Invoice changes, new bank details, payment urgency |
| **Account Compromise** | Legitimate account taken over | Unusual sending patterns, forwarding rules, new IPs |
| **Attorney Impersonation** | Fake legal requests | Confidentiality claims, urgent wire transfers |
| **Data Theft** | Requesting W-2s, PII, or sensitive data | HR/Finance targeting, bulk data requests |

---

### 🔍 BEC Hunting Queries

content.query:
// Domain Impersonation Detection
// Detect emails where anti-phishing policies flagged domain impersonation
EmailEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EmailActionPolicy has_any ("Anti-phishing", "domain impersonation", "impersonation")
| summarize 
    Count = count(),
    Recipients = make_set(RecipientEmailAddress, 10),
    UniqueRecipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress),
    Subjects = make_set(Subject, 5),
    Actions = make_set(DeliveryAction, 5),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, SenderDisplayName
| extend ThreatLevel = case(
    Count > 50, "🔴 Critical - Mass Impersonation",
    Count > 20, "🔴 High",
    Count > 5, "🟠 Medium",
    "🟡 Low")
| order by Count desc
| project ThreatLevel, SenderDisplayName, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, Count, UniqueRecipients, Subjects, Actions, FirstSeen, LastSeen
content.title: 🎭 Domain Impersonation Attempts

content.query:
// BEC Subject Line Analysis - Financial Keywords
// Hunt for emails with financial/urgent subject lines
let BECKeywords = dynamic(["urgent", "wire", "transfer", "payment", "invoice", "bank", "account", "confidential", "immediate", "asap", "w-2", "w2", "tax", "payroll", "ach", "direct deposit", "vendor", "supplier"]);
EmailEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| extend SubjectLower = tolower(Subject)
| where SubjectLower has_any (BECKeywords)
| extend MatchedKeywords = extract_all(@"(urgent|wire|transfer|payment|invoice|bank|account|confidential|immediate|asap|w-2|w2|tax|payroll|ach|direct deposit|vendor|supplier)", SubjectLower)
| where array_length(MatchedKeywords) > 0
| summarize 
    Count = count(),
    Recipients = make_set(RecipientEmailAddress, 5),
    Subjects = make_set(Subject, 5),
    DeliveredCount = countif(DeliveryAction == "Delivered"),
    BlockedCount = countif(DeliveryAction == "Blocked")
    by SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, SenderDisplayName
| where Count > 1
| extend RiskLevel = case(
    DeliveredCount > 10, "🔴 Critical - Many Delivered",
    DeliveredCount > 5, "🟠 High",
    DeliveredCount > 0, "🟡 Medium",
    "🟢 Blocked")
| order by DeliveredCount desc, Count desc
| project RiskLevel, SenderDisplayName, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, Count, DeliveredCount, BlockedCount, Subjects, Recipients
content.title: 💰 BEC Keyword Detection (Financial/Urgent)

content.query:
// Authentication Failures - Spoofing Attempts
// Emails failing SPF/DKIM/DMARC
EmailEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| where AuthenticationDetails has_any ("fail", "none", "softfail")
| extend 
    SPFResult = extract(@"spf=([a-z]+)", 1, tolower(AuthenticationDetails)),
    DKIMResult = extract(@"dkim=([a-z]+)", 1, tolower(AuthenticationDetails)),
    DMARCResult = extract(@"dmarc=([a-z]+)", 1, tolower(AuthenticationDetails))
| where SPFResult in ("fail", "softfail", "none") or DKIMResult in ("fail", "none") or DMARCResult in ("fail", "none")
| summarize 
    FailCount = count(),
    Recipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress),
    Subjects = make_set(Subject, 3),
    DeliveredCount = countif(DeliveryAction == "Delivered")
    by SenderFromDomain, SPFResult, DKIMResult, DMARCResult
| where FailCount > 5
| extend AuthStatus = strcat("SPF:", coalesce(SPFResult, "-"), " DKIM:", coalesce(DKIMResult, "-"), " DMARC:", coalesce(DMARCResult, "-"))
| extend RiskLevel = case(
    DMARCResult == "fail" and DeliveredCount > 0, "🔴 DMARC Fail - Delivered",
    SPFResult == "fail" and DKIMResult == "fail", "🔴 Both SPF/DKIM Fail",
    "🟠 Authentication Issues")
| order by DeliveredCount desc
| project RiskLevel, SenderFromDomain, AuthStatus, FailCount, Recipients, DeliveredCount, Subjects
content.title: 🔓 Email Authentication Failures (SPF/DKIM/DMARC)

content.query:
// Display Name Spoofing Detection
// External senders using internal-looking display names
let InternalDomains = EmailEvents
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where EmailDirection == "Outbound"
    | distinct SenderFromDomain;
EmailEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| where isnotempty(SenderDisplayName)
| extend DisplayNameLower = tolower(SenderDisplayName)
// Look for display names containing common executive titles or internal patterns
| where DisplayNameLower has_any ("ceo", "cfo", "cto", "ciso", "president", "director", "vp", "chief", "executive", "manager", "hr", "human resources", "payroll", "accounting", "finance")
| join kind=leftanti InternalDomains on $left.SenderFromDomain == $right.SenderFromDomain
| summarize 
    Count = count(),
    Recipients = make_set(RecipientEmailAddress, 5),
    Domains = make_set(SenderFromDomain, 5),
    Subjects = make_set(Subject, 3),
    DeliveredCount = countif(DeliveryAction == "Delivered")
    by SenderDisplayName
| where Count > 1
| extend RiskLevel = case(
    DeliveredCount > 5, "🔴 Critical - Executive Impersonation",
    DeliveredCount > 0, "🟠 High - Delivered",
    "🟡 Blocked")
| order by DeliveredCount desc
| project RiskLevel, SenderDisplayName, Count, DeliveredCount, Domains, Subjects, Recipients
content.title: 👔 Display Name Spoofing (Executive Impersonation)

content.query:
// Internal Account Compromise Detection
// Look for unusual outbound email patterns that may indicate compromised accounts

## 🟠 Adversary-in-the-Middle (AiTM) Phishing Detection

**MITRE ATT&CK:** T1557 - Adversary-in-the-Middle, T1539 - Steal Web Session Cookie

AiTM attacks use reverse proxy infrastructure to intercept credentials AND session tokens, bypassing MFA. This section correlates email phishing attempts with sign-in anomalies to detect AiTM attacks.

---

### 🔍 AiTM Attack Indicators

| Indicator | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Phishing Email → Quick Sign-in** | User receives phishing email, then signs in from unusual location |
| **Session Token Theft** | Successful MFA followed by impossible travel |
| **Evilginx/Modlishka Infrastructure** | Known AiTM proxy domains |
| **OAuth Consent Phishing** | Malicious app consent requests |

// AiTM Correlation: Phishing Email + Suspicious Sign-in

    | project UserPrincipalName = RecipientEmailAddress, PhishEmails, LastPhish;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType == "0" // Successful sign-ins
| join kind=inner PhishingRecipients on UserPrincipalName
| where TimeGenerated > LastPhish // Sign-in after phishing email
| where datetime_diff('hour', TimeGenerated, LastPhish) <= 24 // Within 24 hours
| extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| extend City = tostring(LocationDetails.city)
| extend TimeSincePhish = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, LastPhish)
| summarize 
    SignInCount = count(),
    Countries = make_set(Country, 5),
    IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 5),
    Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5),
    AvgMinutesAfterPhish = avg(TimeSincePhish)
    by UserPrincipalName, PhishEmails
| extend RiskLevel = case(
    AvgMinutesAfterPhish < 30, "🔴 Critical - Quick Compromise",
    AvgMinutesAfterPhish < 60, "🔴 High - Fast Response",
    AvgMinutesAfterPhish < 240, "🟠 Medium",

## 🔍 Advanced Hunting - M365 Defender Exclusive Tables

This tab surfaces telemetry from **M365 Defender Advanced Hunting** tables that are
NOT part of the classic Microsoft Sentinel schema. These require **M365 Defender
streaming into your workspace** (via the M365 Defender data connector) OR you can
switch each step's **Data source** dropdown to `Advanced hunting` in the workbook
editor.

Every query below uses `union isfuzzy=true` so the section stays healthy even if
one of these tables has not yet been onboarded in your tenant.

| Table | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `CampaignInfo` | Multi-signal phishing / malware **campaigns** correlated by M365D |
| `MessageEvents` | **Microsoft Teams** message flow (internal, external, federated) |
| `MessagePostDeliveryEvents` | ZAP / retroactive actions on **Teams messages** |
| `MessageUrlInfo` | URLs surfaced inside **Teams messages** |
| `CallActivityEvents` | **Teams call** telemetry (external / federated / anonymous) |
| `FileMaliciousContentInfo` | Malicious content detected in **SharePoint / OneDrive / Teams** files |

> ℹ️  Content in this tab is intentionally scoped to signals **not** already covered by
> other tabs (EmailEvents, EmailPostDeliveryEvents, UrlClickEvents, EmailAttachmentInfo,
> EmailUrlInfo are surfaced elsewhere and are not duplicated here).

### 🧭 Campaigns  
_M365 Defender correlates related phishing / malware messages into `CampaignInfo` — a signal not present in Sentinel-only workspaces._

content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"// M365D Campaigns Overview - KPIs

    | where Timestamp > ago(30d))
| summarize
    Campaigns          = dcount(CampaignId),
    CampaignRecords    = count(),
    UniqueMessages     = dcount(NetworkMessageId),
    RecipientsTargeted = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress)
| mv-expand Metric = pack_array("🧭 Campaigns","📝 Campaign Records","✉️ Unique Messages","👥 Recipients Targeted") to typeof(string),
             Value  = pack_array(Campaigns, CampaignRecords, UniqueMessages, RecipientsTargeted) to typeof(long)
| project Metric, Value
